blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Rank counts only communities with at least ten homes listed. Falling listings with steady sales mean homes are being absorbed faster; rising listings with steady sales mean more choice for buyers. A sellers’ best bet is a community where homes sell quickly against the number listed; a buyers’ best bet is the reverse. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Between June 2026 and September 2026, detached houses: listings rose from 27 in June to 30 in September (+11.1%), and it took 9.0% of the city’s 188 sales over the period; condos and townhomes: listings fell from 9 in June to 5 in September (−44.4%), and it took 4.3% of the city’s 184 sales over the period.
The monthly write-ups singled out Northwest for detached houses in June (a sellers’ best bet); condos and townhomes in June, July (a sellers’ best bet).

items.t: The page is headed "Northwest Maple Ridge Homes for Sale," with editorial copy, a market/census snapshot block and a live feed whose visible cards are all labelled with the board sub-area "Northwest Maple Ridge" — including a condo card, a detached-house card, and two Land listings on Hartnell Avenue.

Identity: this page maps directly to the SnapStats board sub-area "Northwest" in the Maple Ridge community. "Northwest" is a board sub-area name; the City's neighbourhood list names Port Hammond, Port Haney and other neighbourhoods on this side of the city, not a City neighbourhood called "Northwest." Street-level board boundary: UNVERIFIED — no public street-level boundary was opened, and no municipal boundary was substituted for it.

Maple Ridge community context (NOT Northwest's figures): Detached median $1,131,000; Condos & Townhomes median $525,000. SnapStats publishes medians at community level only, has NO land category, and publishes no Northwest median: UNVERIFIED at sub-area level, as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR/GVR September 2026 report.

SD42 has no middle tier (elementary K–7, secondary 8–12). Catchments are address-based and no SD42 locator run for a Northwest address is on record, so catchment schools for any specific address — including whether any Maple Ridge address catchments to Davie Jones — are UNVERIFIED.

Health care: Ridge Meadows Hospital, 11666 Laity Street, Maple Ridge, is the Fraser Health community hospital for Maple Ridge and Pitt Meadows with 24/7 emergency care; the Ridge Meadows Urgent and Primary Care Centre is inside Haney Place Mall, 121 – 11900 Haney Place, open 7 days a week, 9:00 a.m.–8:00 p.m.
How people search for it: "Northwest Maple Ridge," "West Maple Ridge" (used inside feed listing text for this sub-area's lots), "Hammond Maple Ridge" for the southwest edge.

items.t: Zoning: Maple Ridge Zoning Bylaw No. 7600-2019: Which zone applies to a specific parcel is confirmed with the City for the address.

Lougheed Transit Corridor: ADOPTED January 27, 2026: per the City record (OCP Amending Bylaw No. 7781-2021; City news release February 4, 2026), running along Lougheed Highway and Dewdney Trunk Road from the city's western boundary to 221 Street, covering this sub-area's south edge. The Albion Area Plan was adopted October 28, 2025, on the city's east side — Albion ground only, never cited for a Northwest parcel.

: Form B (SPA s.59) within 7 days, max $35 + 25¢/page, with rules, budget and most recent depreciation report attached; depreciation reports on a 5-year cycle for stratas with 5+ lots since Jul 1, 2024; minimum 10% CRF contribution since Nov 1, 2023; rental-restriction bylaws VOID since Nov 24, 2022 (short-term may still be restricted); only 55+ age bylaws valid (SPA ss.123.1/123.2 + Reg 7.01 + May 1, 2023 exemptions) — a "45+" listing line is NOT a valid BC age bylaw. items.t: SD42 has no middle tier — elementary is Kindergarten to Grade 7 and secondary is Grades 8 to 12.

Transit, parks and health: Maple Meadows Station serves Maple Ridge's west side and Port Haney Station, 22300 River Road, runs weekday West Coast Express trains between Waterfront (downtown Vancouver) and Mission City. TransLink's Langley–Haney Place BRT is in detailed planning (22 km, Willowbrook to Haney Place), with designs, costs and timelines not yet determined. Nearest hospital: Ridge Meadows Hospital, 11666 Laity Street, Maple Ridge, with 24/7 emergency care.

Flood frame: the City publishes North and South Alouette River and Fraser River floodplain maps, and the Fraser River flood construction level is 6.7 m geodetic (including freeboard), with no habitable floor space below that level on affected lots and rental accommodation (suites) prohibited on floodplain properties under Zoning Bylaw s.402.8(h). Parcel-level flood status: unconfirmed.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect acreage buyers in Northwest Maple Ridge

items.t: City zoning: A specific parcel's zone is confirmed with the City per parcel.

Suites / SSMUH (City): one secondary suite per lot inside the single detached building, maximum 40% of gross floor area, not within the floodplain area; eligible single-detached and duplex lots may have up to three, four or six units under the City's SSMUH bylaws. On ALR land the ALC suite rule (inside the principal residence only) is the controlling frame for that parcel.

Floodplain: no habitable floor space below the 6.7 m Fraser River flood construction level (including freeboard) on affected lots, and suites are prohibited on floodplain properties under Zoning Bylaw s.402.8(h).

faq.q: Which plan covers Northwest Maple Ridge?
faq.a: The City of Maple Ridge Official Community Plan — updated November 25, 2025 on the settled position in this program. No neighbourhood area plan covers the northwest residential area itself, and the guide page's claim that the Lougheed Transit Corridor Area Plan was adopted on January 27, 2026 conflicts with City sources showing only initial readings at the end of 2025; that conflict is recorded as a live-page error in Section 1 of this file.

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in Northwest Maple Ridge than in June?
faq.a: In Northwest Maple Ridge, listings of houses rose from 27 in June to 30 in September (+11.1%); condos and townhomes fell from 9 in June to 5 in September (−44.4%).

faq.q: How big is Northwest Maple Ridge compared with the rest of Maple Ridge?
faq.a: In September 2026, Northwest Maple Ridge held 7.3% of the 410 houses listed in Maple Ridge and 1.7% of the 286 condos and townhomes listed in Maple Ridge.

faq.q: How many homes sold in Northwest Maple Ridge from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 17 houses and 8 condos and townhomes sold in Northwest Maple Ridge over those 4 months.

faq.q: Can I buy a vacant building lot here?
faq.a: Lot-by-lot only — the feed showed two Hartnell Avenue Land listings described in listing text as build-ready infill lots, but no named subdivision selling serviced lots was verified. Each lot is checked on its own zone (Bylaw No. 7600-2019), ALR status, floodplain status and servicing confirmation with the City.

faq.q: Is the sub-area really split at Abernethy Way — serviced lots south, farms north?
faq.a: Price a parcel on its own checks, not on which side of a marketing line it sits.

faq.q: Is The Meadows verified townhouse stock I can rely on?
faq.a: It is also a different complex from The Meadows at Verigin's Ridge in Cottonwood.

faq.q: Can I add a suite or more units to a Northwest lot?
faq.a: One secondary suite per lot inside the house, up to 40% of gross floor area and not in the floodplain area; eligible single-detached and duplex lots may have up to three, four or six units under the City's SSMUH bylaws — on non-ALR lots only.

faq.q: Is my lot in the ALR or the floodplain?
faq.a: Both are per-parcel checks: ALR status on the ALC mapping, floodplain status on the City's Alouette/Fraser floodplain maps. On floodplain lots, no habitable floor space may sit below the 6.7 m flood construction level and suites are prohibited.

faq.q: Are the Hartnell Avenue lots a subdivision?
faq.a: Confirm servicing and approvals with the City for the specific lot.

faq.q: Was the Lougheed Transit Corridor plan actually adopted?
faq.a: Yes — ADOPTED January 27, 2026 per the City record, running to 221 Street. Confirm a specific south-edge lot's corridor position with the City before valuing it on the corridor.

faq.q: Can a Northwest house have a suite or more units?
faq.a: One secondary suite per lot inside the house (maximum 40% of gross floor area, not in the floodplain area), with SSMUH paths to three, four or six units on eligible lots — and on floodplain properties suites are prohibited outright under Zoning Bylaw s.402.8(h).

faq.q: What were Northwest's own market figures in September 2026?
faq.a: The Maple Ridge community medians (detached $1,131,000; attached $525,000) are community context, expressly not Northwest's.
